name: Profile Card
description: An avatar that morphs into a full profile card using shared layout animation. Click the avatar to expand; click anywhere to dismiss.

variations.name: navbar
variations.previewHint: Tap the avatar in the top-right to expand the profile card
variations.description: Small avatar in a phone frame expands via layoutId into a floating profile card with staggered menu groups.

props.name: name
props.description: Display name shown in the expanded card header.

props.name: email
props.description: Email shown below the name in the expanded card header.

props.name: avatar
props.description: Avatar slot rendered both collapsed (36px) and expanded (42px). Defaults to DefaultAvatar. Pass an , next/image, or any node.

props.name: menuItems
props.description: Flat list of menu rows. Defaults to the built-in Profile/Community/Subscription/Settings/Help/Sign out set.

props.name: menuItems[].icon
props.description: HugeIcons icon component rendered in the row.

props.name: menuItems[].badge
props.description: Trailing slot — pass a count pill, a PRO badge, or any node.

props.name: menuItems[].dividerAfter
props.description: Renders a full-width divider below this row — used to group rows without needing a nested array.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional classes on the root wrapper.

features: Two shared layout transitions run in parallel on one duration spring (duration 0.5, bounce 0.25): layoutId "profile-card" projects the box from 40px to 310px while layoutId "profile-avatar" carries the avatar as its own child, so the avatar interpolates 36px to 42px as a circle instead of stretching with the widening container — one continuous morph, no clone or swap

Header text and menu rows live in a fade wrapper decoupled from the morph: opacity and a blur(4px) to blur(0px) filter animate on an ease-out tween delayed 0.18s, so content resolves into a card that has already settled rather than smearing during the layout projection

A menuReady gate holds the rows pointer-events-none for 400ms (the fade's 0.18s delay plus 0.2s duration) after open, so a fast press or the opening click's mouse-up can't activate a row while it is still invisible

splitIntoSegments derives dividers from a flat menuItems array: a per-row dividerAfter flag starts a new group, keeping badge, active-row highlight, and onClick as composable per-item slots without a nested array shape

Dismiss is an AnimatePresence overlay pinned absolute inset-0 to the component's own box (fades 0.15s) with the collapsed trigger switched to pointerEvents none while open; rows give a whileTap scale-0.98 press and focus as native motion.buttons, though the menu ships pointer-first with no role="menu" contract or prefers-reduced-motion fallback yet
